content:
Andy Robertson asserts that bolstering Liverpool's defensive performance will be crucial if Arne Slot aims to mount a title challenge during his inaugural season. The team has successfully maintained a clean sheet in their first two fixtures, but they face a challenging encounter on Sunday with a trip to Manchester United, where the defensive unit is anticipated to face a more rigorous examination. In their opening games against Ipswich and Brentford, Liverpool's defense remained untested, presenting Slot with an ideal start to his tenure.

Handle the defensive issues that plagued them last season—where Liverpool conceded 41 goals over the course of 38 matches, finishing third in the table—was critical to their aspirations. This performance left them seven goals behind the champions, Manchester City, and twelve worse than second-placed Arsenal. However, the early indications this season suggest a positive shift. Robertson commented, “In our first two matches, we’ve managed to achieve two clean sheets, which has exceeded our expectations.” He emphasized the importance of continuing this momentum, particularly against Manchester United, with hopes of minimizing their opportunities. Furthermore, he expressed aspirations of maintaining such defensive solidity against all subsequent opponents after the international break.

Ultimately, taking lessons from last season's statistics becomes imperative. Robertson reflected that, even during the season when Liverpool was still in contention for the title, they had been conceding more chances compared to both Arsenal and Manchester City. "When you allow such opportunities, it only takes one game for the errors to catch up with you, which has indeed proven to be our downfall," he added. In light of this, the emphasis remains on not only improving the backline but also ensuring the squad can withstand the different challenges presented by their rivals throughout the season.

P.S. The concentrated effort on enhancing Liverpool's defensive capabilities reflects a broader intent to secure a title challenge, underscoring the importance of a solid backline in achieving success in a highly competitive league.
